summary: SCHMID Group N.V. filed a Form 6-K on May 26, 2026, disclosing multiple share issuances: a private placement to four Schmid family members to offset EUR 30.75 million in financial liabilities at a VWAP of USD 7.3309 per share (with a 20% discount on EUR 2.4 million), and issuances to board members, key employees, and CFO/COO for compensation. Additionally, shares were issued to Yorkville as a SEPA commitment fee and upon conversion of convertible notes. These actions are operational capital management, not a standalone special situation event. No board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms beyond the VWAP pricing are cited. The filing reflects routine financing and compensation adjustments, not an M&A, restructuring, or activist campaign.
